title: Swift OpenAPI Generator configuration
description: The openapi-generator-config.yaml file used by the Swift OpenAPI Generator build plugin and command-line tool.

accessModifier.description: The access modifier used for the API of generated code. Defaults to internal.

additionalImports.description: Names of additional modules imported in every generated Swift file.

additionalFileComments.description: Comments added to the top of every generated Swift file.

filter.description: Filter to apply to the OpenAPI document before generation.

operations.description: Operations with these operation IDs are included.

tags.description: Operations tagged with these tags are included.

paths.description: Operations for these paths are included.

namingStrategy.description: The strategy for converting OpenAPI identifiers into Swift identifiers. Defaults to defensive.

nameOverrides.description: Overrides for how individual OpenAPI identifiers are converted to Swift identifiers.

typeOverrides.description: Replaces generated types with custom types.

schemas.description: Maps a schema name, such as Foo in #/components/schemas/Foo, to a custom type name.
